name: B10-0424/2026 – § 15 – Am 104
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 15.Requests that the Commission provide a comprehensive overview of all cases of EU funds allegedly awarded to persons and entities suspected of links to the Muslim Brotherhood or political Islam; recalls that any decision to suspend or withdraw EU funding from an organisation, or otherwise affect its access to public resources, must be based on an individual assessment of concrete and substantiated facts, including proven violations of applicable legal obligations, and must comply with the principles of the rule of law, legal certainty, proportionality and equal treatment; stresses that such decisions cannot be based on assumptions, affiliations, broad or unsubstantiated accusations, or the mere exercise of lawful democratic activities such as advocacy, community engagement or dialogue with public institutions;
